content.text:
probe rmdir rc=0
=== can we un-thread buildkit (a NON-namespace-root threaded cgroup)? ===
buildkit.threads=0 rc=0
buildkit type now: threaded
=== namespace root ===
root.threads=0 rc=0
root type now: domain threaded

observation.command:
rmdir /sys/fs/cgroup/probe 2>&1; echo "probe rmdir rc=$?"
echo "=== can we un-thread buildkit (a NON-namespace-root threaded cgroup)? ==="
echo 0 > /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/buildkit/cgroup.threads; echo "buildkit.threads=0 rc=$?"
echo "buildkit type now: $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/buildkit/cgroup.type)"
echo "=== namespace root ==="
echo 0 > /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.threads; echo "root.threads=0 rc=$?"
echo "root type now: $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.type)"
